newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RTRS-Westpac joins NZ variable mortgage rate rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac joins NZ variable mortgage rate rise.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corporation, trading in New Zealand as WestpacTrust, said on Tuesday it was raising its variable mortgage rate to 10.40 percent from 8.95 percent, effective immediately for new borrowers and from September 8 for existing borrowers.
WestpacTrust chief executive Harry Price said in a statement the recent sharp rise in wholesale interest rates had forced the increase.

The bank joins about half of the main New Zealand home lenders now with variable rates at around this higher rate level of around 10 percent or above, and others have indicated they will consider following the trend in due course.
